items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: he could be writing for Lawrence or for Johnny or for Coote for Carney or for Poole or for Kearney

ctx.x: He was, as he called himself, 'I'm just the piano player!' -- and Duke, as we know, was no slouch as a piano player, but he did write for the musicians and he always knew for whom he was writing -- he could be writing for Lawrence or for Johnny or for Coote for Carney or for Poole or for Kearney, you know. What's it like to be writing for myself? I would like

That's part of the decision, too --what I'm gonna play, you know. I would like to do something in the nature of a suite for a saxophone or, what you might call a concerto or something, you know -- something that wouldn't be too challenging technically, because I don't know how much practice time I'm gonna be able to put in, you know?
